glossEn: a nonspecific agent that imparts motion
note: a nonspecific agent that imparts motion。抽象义。线索：the motor of growth。**注意这个词在中文语境里译作「马」，英语里其实完全不用**（horse 才是马）—— 这是典型的中英词义错位。

glossEn: machine that converts other forms of energy into mechanical energy and so imparts motion
note: machine that converts other forms of energy into mechanical power。线索：a motor engine / motor vehicle / motor industry。**英语 motor 不等于「汽车」**，car 才是。中文三个形容词义对应这一个英文义位。
